name: Curbside Cafe
notes: 3 photos: two are the coffee/beverage price boards from different price eras (espresso bar, smoothies, beer & wine) - drinks only, skipped per rules; one shows the food side of the laminated menu (Health Kick, On The Lighter Side, From The Bakery, Afterthoughts, Ice Cream) and dishes were taken from that photo. A few Afterthoughts prices were faded/cut off at the page edge and omitted rather than guessed; obvious add-ons (side of salsa/hollandaise/gravy, scoop of tuna or chicken salad, chicken breast, cheese) were skipped as modifiers.
